seo.page_title: Token Sweep - Batch Transfer ERC20 Tokens | BiuBiu Tools
seo.page_description: Efficiently sweep and consolidate multiple ERC20 tokens across wallets. Support for Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base networks. Fast, secure, and gas-optimized.
seo.keywords: token sweep, ERC20 transfer, batch transfer, crypto tools, web3 tools, ethereum tools, polygon tools, DeFi tools, token consolidation
seo.webapp_description: Efficiently sweep and consolidate multiple ERC20 tokens across wallets. Support for Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base networks.
seo.feature_2: Multi-network support (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base)
seo.howto_name: How to Batch Transfer ERC20 Tokens with Token Sweep
seo.howto_description: Step-by-step guide to sweep and consolidate multiple ERC20 tokens across wallets using BiuBiu Token Sweep tool.
seo.step_1_text: Click the "Connect Wallet" button and select your preferred Web3 wallet provider (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, etc.). Approve the connection request in your wallet.
seo.step_2_text: Verify the blockchain network connection and ensure all required smart contracts are accessible. The system will automatically detect and validate the necessary components.
seo.step_3_text: Choose which ERC20 tokens you want to sweep from the available list. You can select multiple tokens to transfer in a single batch operation.
seo.step_4_text: Import the source wallet addresses that contain the tokens you want to sweep. You can add multiple wallet addresses to collect tokens from all of them.
seo.step_5_text: Review the transaction summary including total tokens, gas fees, and destination address. Click "Execute Transfer" and confirm the transaction in your wallet. Wait for blockchain confirmation and view the transaction receipt.

sidebar.title: Select Network & Connect Wallet
sidebar.description: Choose a blockchain network and connect your wallet to start sweeping tokens.
sidebar.what_item1: Select a blockchain network (Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, etc.)
sidebar.why_explanation: Tell the app which network to use, and which wallet's assets to operate on - both are essential.
sidebar.network_explanation: A blockchain network is a public ledger system that records who owns what tokens and all transfers. Ethereum, BSC, and Polygon are different ledgers, each independent and separate.
sidebar.wallet_explanation: A Web3 wallet isn't where money is stored - it's the key to manage your blockchain account. Your funds are recorded on the blockchain ledger, and the wallet proves you own the account. Popular: MetaMask, Coinbase Smart Wallet.
sidebar.native_token_explanation: Native tokens are used to pay miners who process your transactions. Ethereum uses ETH, BSC uses BNB, Polygon uses POL. Miners record your transaction on the blockchain ledger, and you pay them this fee.
sidebar.eip7702_explanation: Tech that temporarily upgrades regular wallets to smart contract wallets during a transaction. No extra deployment needed.
sidebar.why_need_eip7702_explanation: Lets wallets with no gas money send tokens. Your main wallet pays gas for them, enabling one-click sweep.
sidebar.create2_proxy_explanation: Deployment tool ensuring same contract address across all chains. Same code = same address everywhere.
sidebar.multicall3_explanation: Batches multiple calls into one. Saves gas and time. All-or-nothing execution.
sidebar.biubiu_premium_explanation: Membership contract managing subscriptions, discounts, and access. Fully open source.
sidebar.token_sweep_explanation: Core contract for batch transfers. Handles EIP-7702 delegation and approvals. Open source: https://github.com/biubiu-tools/contracts
sidebar.tip1: ✅ Make sure you selected the correct network (choose where your tokens are)
sidebar.tip2: ⛽ Ensure you have enough native tokens to pay fees
sidebar.tip3: 🌍 Supports any EVM-compatible network - you can add any chain

items.question: What is biubiu.tools?
items.answer: biubiu.tools is a comprehensive Web3 toolkit that provides batch operations and multi-wallet management features for the Ethereum ecosystem.

items.question: Is it safe to use?
items.answer: Yes! We never store your private keys. All operations are performed locally in your browser using secure Web3 protocols.

items.question: Which chains are supported?
items.answer: We support Ethereum mainnet and major EVM-compatible chains including Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, and Optimism.

items.question: How does batch wallet collection work?
items.answer: Our tool allows you to collect tokens from multiple wallets to a single address in one transaction, saving time and gas fees.

items.question: Can I try it for free?
items.answer: Absolutely! Our free plan includes basic features with up to 10 wallets. You can upgrade anytime for more advanced features.
